title.en: Anthropic doubled 5-hour limits, removed peak-hour throttling
title.zh-Hans: Anthropic 将 5 小时额度翻倍，并取消高峰时段限流

body.en: Since May 6, 2026 the 5-hour window limits are doubled for Pro, Max, Team and seat-based Enterprise plans, and the weekday 8 AM–2 PM ET peak-hour reduction no longer applies. Weekly (7-day) caps are unchanged.
body.zh-Hans: 自 2026 年 5 月 6 日起，Pro、Max、Team 及按席位的 Enterprise 套餐的 5 小时窗口额度翻倍，工作日美东 8AM–2PM 的高峰限流同时取消。周（7 天）上限保持不变。
